parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: Explain what is meant by gravitational potential energy and kinetic energy.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A ball of mass 400 g is thrown with an initial velocity of 30.0 m s^{-1} at an angle of 45.0° to the
horizontal, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
Air resistance is negligible. The ball reaches a maximum height H after a time of 2.16 s.
parts.question_text_latex:
A ball of mass 400 g is thrown with an initial velocity of 30.0 m $s^{-1}$ at an angle of 45.0° to the
horizontal, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
Air resistance is negligible. The ball reaches a maximum height H after a time of 2.16 s.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate
1. the initial kinetic energy of the ball,
kinetic energy = J
2. the maximum height H of the ball,
H = m
3. the gravitational potential energy of the ball at height H.
potential energy = J
